about_the_game:
For Years, Sole Developer, CatTrigger has been developing horror games and stories. Now, they're all finally compiled into this tight-knit collection!

This collection comes with Director's Cut material from all of CatTrigger's games, Behind-the-Scenes Material, comics as well as... a DARK SECRET WITHIN THE COLLECTION ITSELF?!

Brutal Health Clinics, Haunted Dating Sims, Sprawling Tunnels and More...

Enjoy 7 horror games by CatTrigger, including Classic Versions of Date Time, Secrets to Success with Dr. Brain, No Robots Allowed & Bad Faith all with Director's Cut content made specifically for the collection.

Investigate the slow horrid mutation of a child in a health clinic, prove you're human to a killer robot or guide a hapless victim through dark sprawling tunnels. Each story is unique in both story and style ranging from Comedy Horror, Sci-Fi and Dreadful Body Horror.

  • 7 Heart Pumping Horror Interactive Stories, each with their own set of characters, secrets and monsters!

  • A small collection of horror comics drawn by CatTrigger, both presented in an animated format, as well as static format for easy reading.

  • Interact and Abuse CatTrigger as you play through their games!

  • THERE'S SOMETHING DREADFUL INSIDE THE COLLECTION ITSELF, CAN YOU FIND IT?

  • Fun Behind-The-Scenes material for each game!

  • I LOVE MY EYES!
